scope: RCL-owned bounded 2x2 RGB sample transform/clamp, horizontal row flip and exact run-length encode/decode; procedural samples, no arbitrary image/video/audio codec or provider generation claim; actual source-to-RBC-to-native-VM compiler workflow with observed process exits, compiler instruction metrics and source/artifact/result binding; local Windows pipeline, no external deployment or whole-family claim

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: Read only named frozen candidate batch; no other filesystem, memory, network, execution, writes or delegation

runtimeControls: actual compiler/VM process exits, compiler instruction and byte metrics
typed roots and source-owned transitions, wrong-root rejection; distributed profile additionally requires three real HTTP nodes

trials.intent: Clamp each transformed RGB channel to the inclusive range zero through 255 before optional inversion.
Horizontal flipping swaps the two RGB pixels within each row, preserving row order and each pixel channel order.
Decode every run by appending its sample exactly count times; retain empty inputs and exact run-length round trips.
